name: flowline-brand-assets
description: Canonical cross-platform brand marks for the Share menu. Single source of truth — Swift WebDoc HTML inlines these verbatim.

slack.usage: Full-color on white/black/aubergine #4A154B only. Never recolor. See README.

teams.source: Fallback MIT-derived (twbs/icons); official 2025 gradient vector is trademark-gated
teams.usage: Replace 1:1 with licensed asset once approved. Wordmark 'Microsoft Teams' in text is allowed.

notion.source: Simple Icons notion (byte-identical to press-kit mark)
notion.usage: Monochrome only (#000 on #FFF, #FFF on #000). Never recolor.

gmail.usage: Full-color on white only. Never single-color. Keep clear-space.

github.usage: Black on light / white on dark only. Use at native 16px.

link.usage: Generic copy-URL row. No brand constraints.
